You must use it regularly and consistently. It absorbs well and quickly and is not greasy.  It has a somewhat medicinal smell (think Noxema), but it is not unpleasant & fades quickly if you are concerned about how you smell to others. This stuff is amazing! I originally bought it to help with skin irritations and ingrown hairs after waxing. I have since incorporated it into general moisturizer, as well as grumpy skin care. It smells wonderful (once the initial shock has died down a little bit, which only takes a few minutes) and it leaves my skin feeling supple, soothed, and smooth.

This is my favorite product of the year! The creme is healing and cooling, and works on any manner of skin abrasion. I hope Derma E continues to make Tea Tree and E Antiseptic Creme because it is shockingly great.

This is creme is probably the one product I cannot live without because it has a broad range of uses. I have used it daily for many years on my oily slightly acne prone skin and it works wonders. It also works on bug bites, sunburn, and rashes. I recently had a bad reaction to sunscreen and this creme provided immediate relief.

reviews.t: I would recommend this product to everyone
reviews.x: I use this product every morning as a moisturizer and put my make-up on over it. I have oily skin and still have problems with acne but this product has helped clear my skin and heal some of my scars. I would recommend this product to everyone!!

I suffer from eczema on my hands and arms and this is the only product that has given me almost immediate relief.  I have steroid creams from my doctor, and OTC anti-itch creams, but none come close to the effectiveness of this miracle cream.  It feels amazing on your skin and I actually enjoy the smell.  It is tea tree scented, of course, but the scent is not overpowering and fades very fast.  I am so happy that I came across this product and that I decided to give it a try for my problem skin.

I've been using this as a face lotion for nearly 10 years. I started using it because I had acne, but I no longer do. But it's still my favorite face lotion. It's thick and hydrating, prevents acne and heals the skin. I hope they never stop making it.

reviews.t: Highly recommend.  Best on the market that I have found.
reviews.x: Awesome stuff.  We have tried so many creams for dryness and healing and this one far exceeds anything on the market.  We live in cold weather and during the winter your hands get so dry they can crack and bleed.  I highly recommend this product.  Bought one for a stocking stuffer for my sister and then bought 2 more for the house so there is one on each level.  Great cream.  Heals within 48 hours.

I started applying a thin layer of cream on my elbows and hands in the morning and before bed and while I saw/felt results after only a few days, nearly a month later my condition is almost entirely clear!

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise it as a versatile, multi-purpose healing cream that works on many skin issues like rashes, blemishes, cuts, sunburns, and bug bites.
Many users report it effectively clears or improves acne, scars, and damaged or cracked skin with regular use.
Users describe it as moisturizing, absorbing well without being greasy, and lasting all day.
The tea tree scent is noted—some find it medicinal or initially shocking but pleasant once accustomed.
A few reviewers caution it can aggravate certain contact dermatitis issues, though it works well for most conditions.
